*   To address the limitation of fixed-scale depth alignment which overlooks small errors, DNGaussian uses Global-Local Depth Normalization [S1].

The claim states that DNGaussian uses Global-Local Depth Normalization to address the limitation of fixed-scale depth alignment which overlooks small errors. Source [S1] explicitly states in Section 3.3: 'Previous depth-supervised neural fields usually build the depth loss on the source scales of the depth maps... This directly supports every part of the claim.
